00044 MixUGenInternal::MixUGenInternal(UGen const& array, bool shouldAllowAutoDelete) throw()
00045 : UGenInternal(1),
00046  shouldAllowAutoDelete_(shouldAllowAutoDelete)
00047 { 
00048  inputs[0] = array;
00049  
00050  float value = 0.f;
00051  for(int i = 0; i < array.getNumChannels(); i++)
00052  {
00053   value += array.getValue(i);
00054  }
00055  
00056  initValue(value);
00057 }
00058 
00059 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00060 void MixUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00061 {
00062  int channel = 0;
00063  
00064  bool shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00065  bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal; 
00066  int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00067  float* const outputSamplesBase = uGenOutput.getSampleData();
00068  const float* channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00069  
00070  float* outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;
00071  while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00072  {
00073   *outputSamples++ = *channelSamples++;
00074  }
00075  
00076  channel++;
00077   
00078  int numChannels = inputs->getNumChannels();
00079  
00080  for(/* leave channel value alone */; channel < numChannels; channel++)
00081  {
00082   shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00083   int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00084   outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;
00085   const float* channelSamples = inputs->processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00086     
00087   while(numSamplesToProcess--)
00088   {
00089    *outputSamples++ += *channelSamples++;
00090   }
00091  }
00092  
00093 }
00094 #endif

00138 float MixArrayUGenInternal::getValue(const int channel) const throw()
00139 {
00140  float value = 0.f;
00141  
00142  for(int i = 0; i < array_.size(); i++)
00143  {
00144   const UGen& ugen = array_[i];
00145   
00146   if(shouldWrapChannels_ || (channel < ugen.getNumChannels()))
00147   {
00148    value += ugen.getValue(channel);
00149   }
00150  }
00151  
00152  return value;
00153 }

00155 #if !defined(UGEN_VFP) && !defined(UGEN_NEON) && !defined(UGEN_VDSP)
00156 void MixArrayUGenInternal::processBlock(bool& shouldDelete, const unsigned int blockID, const int /*channel*/) throw()
00157 { 
00158  bool shouldDeleteLocal;
00159  bool& shouldDeleteToPass = shouldAllowAutoDelete_ ? shouldDelete : shouldDeleteLocal; 
00160  const int numOutputChannels = getNumChannels();
00161  const int blockSizeBytes = uGenOutput.getBlockSize() * sizeof(float);
00162  const int arraySize = array_.size();
00163  const int numSamplesToProcess = uGenOutput.getBlockSize();
00164  
00165  for(int channel = 0; channel < numOutputChannels; channel++)
00166  {
00167   float * const outputSamplesBase = proxies[channel]->getSampleData();
00168   memset(outputSamplesBase, 0, blockSizeBytes);
00169 
00170   for(int arrayIndex = 0; arrayIndex < arraySize; arrayIndex++)
00171   {
00172    UGen& ugen = array_[arrayIndex];
00173    
00174    if(ugen.isNull(channel)) continue;
00175    
00176    if(shouldWrapChannels_ || (channel < ugen.getNumChannels()))
00177    {
00178     shouldDeleteLocal = false;
00179     float* outputSamples = outputSamplesBase;
00180     const float* channelSamples = ugen.processBlock(shouldDeleteToPass, blockID, channel);
00181           
00182     for(int i = 0; i < numSamplesToProcess; ++i)
00183     {
00184      outputSamples[i] += channelSamples[i];
00185     }
00186    }
00187   }
00188  }
00189 }
00190 #endif

00214 void Mix::constructMixArrayWithProxies(MixArrayUGenInternal* internal)
00215 {
00216  int numProxies = internal->getNumProxies();
00217  initInternal(numProxies + 1);
00218  
00219  internalUGens[0] = internal;
00220  internalUGens[0]->initValue(internal->getValue(0));
00221  
00222  if(numProxies > 0)
00223  {
00224   for(int i = 1; i <= numProxies; i++)
00225   {
00226    internalUGens[i] = internal->getProxy(i);
00227    internalUGens[i]->initValue(internal->getValue(i));
00228   }
00229  } 
00230 }
